description: Fetch the current status of a transcription job (and transcript when completed). Poll until status is completed, failed, or cancelled. Pass response_format ('srt', 'vtt', or 'verbose_json') on a completed job to fetch it re-formatted.

job_id.description: Job id returned by a create or wait-first transcription tool.

response_format.description: Optional transcript format. Omit for the default plain transcript. 'srt'/'vtt' return subtitle-file text; 'verbose_json' includes timestamped segments.

name: get_job_status
title: Get job status
